/ 15. (Item wording is placeholder: swap in brew's real list.)

"Every frame, before you ever see it."
A rhythm of soft ticks that resolves into a chord.

g.text: SHOT 18 — EVERY FRAME WATCHED BY A PERSON

svg.text: Every frame watched by a person
Hero type, the site's own line: "Every frame watched by a person." "person" in brand
green, framed by small brackets. Pills: REVIEWED done, DELIVERED lights.
Words rise through a mask, 40ms stagger; the brackets snap around "person". Speed
returns to 100% on the cut out.
